import tempfile
import unittest
from pathlib import Path

from model_runtime.extract_agent_result import extract


class ExtractAgentResultTests(unittest.TestCase):
    def test_extracts_last_result_json(self):
        with tempfile.TemporaryDirectory() as tmp:
            log = Path(tmp) / "run.log"
            log.write_text(
                "hello\n"
                '{"ok": true, "job_id": "job1", "branch": "ai/test"}\n',
                encoding="utf-8",
            )
            result = extract(log)
            self.assertEqual(result["branch"], "ai/test")


if __name__ == "__main__":
    unittest.main()

#!/usr/bin/env bash
set -euo pipefail

ROOT="$(cd "$(dirname "${BASH_SOURCE[0]}")/.." && pwd)"
HANDOFF_JSON="${HERMCLAW_HANDOFF_JSON:-/tmp/hermclaw-benutzerfilter-handoff.json}"
MODEL_ALIAS="${HERMCLAW_MAIN_ALIAS:-local-coder-qwen3coder30-24k}"
AGENT_BIN="${HERMCLAW_AGENT_BIN:-/home/kiworker/noob2claw_runtime/bin/hermclaw-agent}"
BASE_BRANCH="${HERMCLAW_BASE_BRANCH:-redesign/autonomous-agent}"
JOB_ID="${HERMCLAW_JOB_ID:-routing-v02-main-$(date +%Y%m%d-%H%M%S)}"
TASK_FILE="${HERMCLAW_TASK_FILE:-}"
RUN_LOG="${HERMCLAW_RUN_LOG:-/tmp/hermclaw-${JOB_ID}.log}"
RUN_META="${HERMCLAW_RUN_META:-/tmp/hermclaw-main-run.json}"
FALLBACK_RESULT="/home/kiworker/noob2claw_runtime/agent-jobs/job-${JOB_ID}/result.json"

cd "$ROOT"

if [[ ! -s "$HANDOFF_JSON" ]]; then
  echo "FEHLER: Handoff fehlt: $HANDOFF_JSON"
  exit 30
fi

if [[ -n "$TASK_FILE" ]]; then
  if [[ ! -s "$TASK_FILE" ]]; then
    echo "FEHLER: Task-Override fehlt: $TASK_FILE"
    exit 31
  fi
  TASK="$(cat "$TASK_FILE")"
else
  TASK="$(python3 -m model_runtime.main_task --handoff "$HANDOFF_JSON")"
fi

echo "===== MAIN TASK ====="
printf "%s\n" "$TASK"

echo
echo "===== MAIN-CODER MODELL VORBEREITEN ====="
python3 -m model_runtime.model_manager prepare main

echo
echo "===== GELADENE MODELLE ====="
python3 -m model_runtime.model_manager status

echo
echo "===== START MAIN CODER / 30B / 24K ====="
echo "[PIPELINE] base: $BASE_BRANCH"
echo "[PIPELINE] job:  $JOB_ID"

set +e
"$AGENT_BIN" run \
  --repo git@hermclaw-gitlab:local-ai/hermclaw.git \
  --base "$BASE_BRANCH" \
  --job-id "$JOB_ID" \
  --model "$MODEL_ALIAS" \
  --context-tokens 24576 \
  --max-output-tokens 4096 \
  --task "$TASK" \
  --push 2>&1 | tee "$RUN_LOG"
AGENT_RC=${PIPESTATUS[0]}
set -e

if [[ $AGENT_RC -ne 0 ]]; then
  echo "FEHLER: Main-Coder beendet mit Exit-Code $AGENT_RC"
  exit "$AGENT_RC"
fi

python3 -m model_runtime.extract_agent_result \
  --log "$RUN_LOG" \
  --fallback-result "$FALLBACK_RESULT" \
  --output "$RUN_META"

echo "[PIPELINE] Main-Ergebnis: $RUN_META"
